name: Ratchthani Leasing Public Company Limited
summary: Ratchthani Leasing Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiary, provides hire-purchase and finance leasing services in Thailand. The company offers hire purchase loans for new and used cars; refinance and car title loans; financial lease; loans for solar panel installation; and loans to car dealerships. It also provides auto and property insurance products, as well as annual tax registration, le, and truck to you services. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. Ratchthani Leasing Public Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Thanachart SPV1 Co., Ltd.
